description.value: Zapoteca is an authentic Mexican restaurant on White Rock's Marine Drive waterfront, opened on Valentine's Day 2018 by a trio of founders with roots in Guadalajara, Guanajuato, and Nelson, BC. Its beloved sidewalk patio has been a fixture of the beachside community for over six years, blending Oaxacan-influenced dishes with local seafood in a lively outdoor setting. Now with a second location in Kitsilano, it remains a cornerstone of White Rock's dining scene.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is rich and confirms an active, established restaurant on Marine Drive in White Rock with a sidewalk patio (corroborated by OSM outdoor_seating=yes) and explicit takeout service. Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-aware options are confirmed via happy-hour menu items (e.g., 'champiñones V', 'vegan chilorio V') and the contact FAQ gluten note. No phone is intentional per the website ('No Phone - Use contact form'). Bike parking is not mentioned anywhere in website content or OSM tags beyond outdoor seating.
concerns: OSM has two conflicting URL fields: 'url' tag points to https://www.zapotecagrill.com while 'website' tag and the fetched content both use https://zapoteca.com/whiterock — the former may be outdated or belong to a different brand entity.
No phone number is intentional per the website ('No Phone - Use contact form'), so no phone contact can be listed for the directory.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, well-documented restaurant with outdoor sidewalk patio seating on Marine Drive — a popular cycling corridor in White Rock — with takeout and vegetarian/vegan options. A solid stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Pets explicitly not permitted in any food service area per contact FAQ. Catering not offered. Maximum reservation size is 8 persons.

Takeout.detail: Dedicated 'Take-out' section in site navigation; website states 'Please make reservations and takeout orders by website only.'

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Happy-hour menu lists 'champiñones V' and 'vegan chilorio V'; contact FAQ notes many menu items are gluten-free and have been enjoyed by celiac guests, though cross-contamination risk is acknowledged

wow_evidence: sidewalk patio has been a fixture of the beachside community for over six years
